entries.title: Ezekiel 18:2
segments:
vv 2-3. 
 
God will in the end make the justice of his dealings with men so apparent that "every mouth shall be stopped, and all the world become guilty" before him.

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:4
segments:
vv 4-23. 
 
God bestows upon children many blessings through the piety of their fathers, and sends upon them many evils through their wickedness,

; but no sinner will be saved for the goodness of his forefathers, nor any righteous man condemned for their wickedness.  At the final reckoning, every one will be called to an account for the deeds he has himself done, whether they be good or bad.

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:6
segments:
Eaten upon the mountains; eaten sacrificial offerings to idols. 
 
  Lifted up his eyes; in worship, with confidence and longing desire. Compare

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:20
segments:
The son shall not bear; be punished for. 
 
  Shall be upon him; he alone shall be rewarded or punished for it.

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:26
segments: It is only perseverance in holiness to the end that can secure eternal life.  Past deeds of righteousness cannot benefit the man who turns from them to the practice of iniquity.

entries.title: Ezekiel 18:27
segments:
vv 27-28. 
 
No sinner, who is willing to repent and turn to God, need be discouraged on account of his past transgressions.
